name: The Sun Gardener
notes: DRAFT for C13-5 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Yellow Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (the scaling guide puts a Guardian at about 90% of the tier max; hits-to-beat in the 40-80 boss band). Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: seed rain
attacks.note: Seeds fall in a few red circles, one after another.

phases.tell: It pulls back a thorny vine; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: The vine pulls back first. Ready.

phases.tell: Seeds glow in the air above you.
A striped arc and double marks.
phases.senseiLine: The vines sweep wide. DASH out.

lines.intro: The garden is tangled. Its keeper is too.
lines.freed: The thorns are gone. My flowers can open again.
lines.senseiAfter: You moved light on your feet. The garden noticed.

description: The Sun Gardener whips thorny vines, rains glowing seeds, then sweeps a long striped arc.

bestiary.tip: Thorns first, then seeds, then stripes.

lore.yellow: A tall, gentle gardener made of vines. The shadow wrapped it in thorns, but its roots still reach for the sun. Free it, and its light comes home.
